requirement_text: The app must launch and be fully loaded and ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of startup.
requirement_reference: Line 2: 'fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting.'

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app to start instantly so that I can use it without delay.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the app is closed, When I tap the app icon, Then the home screen is fully loaded within two seconds.

requirement_text: The app must function reliably even when network coverage is limited and must retain basic usability during intermittent or lost connections, supporting offline mode for core features.
requirement_reference: Lines 22, 23: 'functions reliably even with limited network coverage.'; 'The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection.'

user_story.story: As a user, I want to keep using the app's main features even if I have a poor or lost network connection.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I lose internet connectivity, When I continue to use the app, Then I can still access news and previously loaded information.

requirement_text: The app must support up to 100,000 concurrent users on match days without perceivable performance loss.
requirement_reference: Line 24: 'our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss.'

user_story.story: As an operator, I want the app to handle high traffic on match days so that all users get a smooth experience.
user_story.Acceptance: Given 100,000 users are simultaneously active during a major match, When they interact with news and live tickers, Then the response times do not noticeably degrade.

requirement_text: The app's modules and user interface must remain stable and functional even if the external server providing live data is updated.
requirement_reference: Line 18: 'All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates.'

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app to always work properly, even if the server backend changes, so that I have a consistent experience.
user_story.Acceptance: Given an update to the external live data server, When I use the app, Then all modules and the interface operate with no visible errors or changes to usability.

requirement_text: The app must undergo a thorough pre-release testing and support process to detect and resolve malfunctions before publication.
requirement_reference: Line 25: 'thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early.'

user_story.story: As a product owner, I want the app tested thoroughly before release so that users experience minimal bugs.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the app is in pre-release, When QA testing is performed, Then all malfunctions and errors are documented and resolved prior to go-live.

requirement_text: The app must continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality following release.
requirement_reference: Line 26: 'user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality.'

user_story.story: As a user, I want my feedback to be considered so that the app gets better over time.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I submit feedback or review, When the product management team reviews it, Then it is tracked and may be included in future updates.

requirement_text: All personal data processed by the app must fully comply with GDPR regulations.
requirement_reference: Line 27: 'All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR.'

user_story.story: As a user, I want to trust that my personal data is handled securely and in accordance with EU laws.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I enter personal data, When it is processed by the app, Then it is always done under full GDPR compliance.
